143011.en: {call|B|A}, feel free to ask me if you want something. I'm always ready to help you.
143011.ch: {call|B|A}，你要什么跟我索取便可，我又岂会拒绝你。

10002001.en: Hahaha! It would not do to let a fighter of your caliber slip past me. Though it may mean the death of me, I shall still have this fight, with nothing held back!
10002001.ch: 哈哈哈，得遇如此高手，在下岂能交臂而失之，便是身死道消，我也想酣畅淋漓地战一场！

10002002.en: {call|B|A}! I have ground my teeth at the thought of you for days. Even if it means my death, I shall make you pay before the day is done!
10002002.ch: {call|B|A}！我已忍耐你多日，纵使今日十死无生，我也要让你付出代价！

10002102.en: To cross swords with the likes of you would be child's play. You must be unaware of the souls that have perished by my hand!
10002102.ch: 纵是你这境界欲同我一战，我亦不惧！阁下怕是不知，我手下亡魂有多少吧！

10004001.en: Extraordinary, that you possess the {0} which I have long sought. Thus, I have no recourse but to take it from you.
10004001.ch: 真是出乎意料，你身上竟有我寻觅已久的{0}，既然如此，岂有不拿的道理？

10004101.en: Since you are reluctant to compromise, let us this day put an end to our vendettas, past and present!
10004101.ch: 既然阁下不愿妥协，那就把往日之仇也一并做个了断吧！

10004201.en: What irony, that you should come into such treasure! It is only natural that I should take it for myself.
10004201.ch: 你竟寻得此等宝物，我若不取为己用，岂不有违天理。

10004301.en: Pilfering your {0} was for a simple exchange of Spirit Stones, not satisfaction for your past wrongs. But since I am discovered, we may as well make a clear account of everything, here and now!
10004301.ch: 今日偷你的{0}不过为了换些灵石，并非为了报仇，但既然被你发现了，那不如把旧账也算清楚！

10004401.en: One as vile as you does not deserve this {0}. I shall rid the world of your pestilence this day!
10004401.ch: 卑劣之人岂配用这{0}，我今日就要用尽全力灭了你这祸害！

10004501.en: This {0} shall be mine. If you will not part with it, then let us fight to the death for it!
10004501.ch: 这{0}我势在必得，你若不愿，那便来个殊死之战吧！

10004601.en: This {0} is an Elixir that will save my {relation|X|B}'s life. I shall have it by any means necessary. Enough talk. Have at you!
10004601.ch: 这{0}是救我的{relation|X|B}的重要丹药，我无论如何也要得到，话不多说，出招吧！

10006001.en: You and I have had enmity between us, and now you wish to give me {0}? Forgive my apprehension, but I cannot accept.
10006001.ch: 你我曾有嫌隙，如今又欲赠我{0}，恕在下无法放下猜忌收下此物。

10008001.en: I would never have guessed that you possess {0}. Could you give it to me as a balm for our relationship?
10008001.ch: 想不到{0}竟在你手里，可否送我？我们也该重修一下关系。

10008101.en: If you would gift to me this {0}, I would set aside my misgivings and entreat with you.
10008101.ch: 倘若你能赠与我{0}，我愿放下成见与你相处。

10008201.en: This {0} may be sufficient for us to resolve our vendetta. Would you be willing to part with it?
10008201.ch: 这{0}也许能化解我们的宿怨，阁下可愿意忍痛割爱？

10008301.en: It is astounding that you have something as precious as this {0}. If you give it to me, I may be able to set aside our differences.
10008301.ch: 你竟有这珍贵的{0}，如阁下愿赠与我，我说不定能放下往日恩怨。

10008401.en: Though it is said that it is far easier to breed enmity than to resolve it, my grudge towards you would be greatly diminished if you gifted {0} to me.
10008401.ch: 虽说结仇易、化仇难，但若你能将{0}送我，或许我对你的怨气能消散不少。

10008501.en: I would like to come to the aid of others with your {0}. I may think more highly of you if you lent it to me.
10008501.ch: 我欲借你这{0}救助他人，望阁下成全。若你愿助一臂之力，我或许会对你高看一眼。

10010001.en: I have no desire to spar with you, and shall take my leave.
10010001.ch: 在下并无同你切磋之意，告辞！

10010101.en: It would be a real eye-opener to witness the skills of one as well-cultivated as you. Let us see if you are as good as you say!
10010101.ch: 阁下道行已如此之深，不如让我开开眼，瞧瞧你这所谓的高手到底是真是假！你可敢应战？

10010201.en: It would seem that you are little more than talk, ascending illusory Realms without actual skill.
10010201.ch: 看来阁下不过是个徒有境界，却无实力的空架子罢了。

10010301.en: I have often taken umbrage with your ways and means, and today I have gained my satisfaction. Hahaha!
10010301.ch: 我素来看不惯你的行事风格，今日可算是解气了！哈哈哈！

10010401.en: Are you not hiding the extent of your abilities? What connivance!
10010401.ch: 阁下莫不是在隐藏本领？真是城府颇深！

10010501.en: Confidence floats ships, but overconfidence sinks them. Take care that you are not caught unawares.
10010501.ch: 阁下不必如此自信，小心可别阴沟里翻船，到时可就贻笑大方了。

10012001.en: So you're the one who's raising the bid, {call|B|C}. As despicable as ever!
10012001.ch: {call|B|C}，竟是你在抬价。哼！不愧是你，依旧如此可憎！

10014001.en: You dare to outbid me, {call|B|C}? A spear in the light is more easily evaded than an arrow from the dark. One day, I will find your weakness.
10014001.ch: {call|B|C}，与我抬价？小心明枪易躲，暗箭难防！我迟早有日会找到你的破绽。

10014002.en: {call|B|C}, you pettifogger! Going against me at every turn, even at the auction!
10014002.ch: {call|B|C}，你这小肚鸡肠之人，竟拍卖时也要与我针锋相对！

10014003.en: A pity that there can be no blood spilled on auction grounds, {call|B|C}, but rest assured that I shall come for my revenge!
10014003.ch: {call|B|C}，拍卖会内不可打斗，等离开此地，我定会使劲浑身解数找你复仇的！

10014004.en: I cannot believe that you resort to raising my bid to get back at me! Have you no shame?
10014004.ch: {call|B|C}，想不到你竟在拍卖时故意抬价来报复我！简直无耻至极！

10014005.en: {call|B|C}, you know that I have more Spirit Stones than there are stars in the sky, and still you wish to outbid me? You overextend yourself!
10014005.ch: {call|B|C}你可知我的灵石已多如牛毛，欲与我比拼灵石，可真是不自量力！

10014006.en: {call|B|C}, if you insist on crossing me, you would do well to watch for the knife in your back. I'm afraid nothing can bring you back from the dead!
10014006.ch: {call|B|C}，你若执意与我相争，小心我暗下杀手！到时恐怕你一切手段都无力回天。

10014007.en: {call|B|C}, your petty antics to raise the bid confirms my opinion of you — imbecile!
10014007.ch: {call|B|C}，你这抬价之举，可真是符合我先前对你的评价——卑劣！

10014008.en: Fighters far stronger than you have lost to those far lesser than me. {call|B|C}, how do you think you will fare?
10014008.ch: 不少高手败于低修为之人，凡事无绝对。{call|B|C}阁下以为呢？

10014009.en: {call|B|C}, I'm afraid you have no idea what I'm capable of. Your vaunted Cultivation will not save this {1}.
10014009.ch: {call|B|C}，阁下怕是还未见识过我的手段吧？到时，可不是你修为高就能守得住这{1}。

10014010.en: Not once have I failed at getting what I want. No matter how your Cultivation, {call|B|C}, you have already lost this {1}!
10014010.ch: 在下想要得到的东西，就从未失手过，{call|B|C}即使你道行深，也不见得能保住这{1}！

10014011.en: {call|B|C}, did you think that the height of your ascension would give me pause? What hubris!
10014011.ch: {call|B|C}，阁下莫不是认为自己境界高，我就不敢下手？可真是夜郎自大。

10014012.en: You reap what you sow, {call|B|C}. Your arrogance will eventually be your downfall!
10014012.ch: 恶人自有恶人磨。{call|B|C}，你如此嚣张，以后指定有你好果子吃！

10014013.en: The depth of your Cultivation belies your ability to make trouble for others, {call|B|C}!
10014013.ch: 在下道行虽浅，但找人麻烦可很在行！{call|B|C},你明白与否?

10014014.en: {call|B|C}! You may have ascended to higher realms, but your collection of Spirit Stones is paltry compared to mine. Give up while you still can!
10014014.ch: {call|B|C}！你境界虽高，但这口袋里的灵石不见得有我多，劝你不如趁早收手！

10014015.en: I say {call|B|C}, with as irritating a temperament as yours, you're looking for trouble if you spend all your Spirit Stones here. You should go and buy some protective elixirs at the market!
10014015.ch: {call|B|C}阁下的性格如此令人生厌，与其在此处花灵石找罪受，不如去坊市买点丹药防身。

10014016.en: {call|B|C}, I will remember your petty upselling act today! One day, I will make you pay!
10014016.ch: {call|B|C}，今日抬价之仇我已深记于心！假以时日，我定会让你付出代价！

10014101.en: Your Cultivation may run deep, but I am not so easily intimidated!
10014101.ch: 阁下修为虽高，但若想以此威胁于我，绝非易事！

1003001.en: You must be tired of living.
1003001.ch: 我看你是活得不耐烦了！

1003002.en: Dude, show me what you can do!
1003002.ch: 好家伙，我倒要看看你到底有何本事！

1003003.en: The scenery is beautiful and the fengshui is auspicious. Could it be you want to be buried here?
1003003.ch: 此处山清水秀，风水俱佳，道友莫非想埋骨于此？

1003004.en: Yes! I was just thinking about you! Today it's either me or you!
1003004.ch: 来得好！我正想找你呢！今日，不是你死便是我亡！

1003005.en: Today is a good day—garbage day!
1003005.ch: 今日正是黄道吉日，合该将你挫骨扬灰！

1003006.en: I will never sleep soundly if I do not kill you today!
1003006.ch: 若要今后能够安睡，今日必须将你杀死！

1003007.en: Hmph. We will see who walks away the victor and who never walks again!
1003007.ch: 哼，今日既分胜负，亦决生死！来吧！

1010002.en: Pah! I know you! Don't you dare!
1010002.ch: 呸！记住你了，给我当心点！

1010003.en: Today's insults will be repaid with interest!
1010003.ch: 今日之辱，来日我必将加倍奉还！

1010004.en: Smart choice. I have friends in high places, people you don't want to piss off! This isn't over, not by a long shot!
1010004.ch: 算你识相，我身后可是你一辈子都惹不起的人！但今日之事还不算完，你给我等着！

1010005.en: Let me go, and I promise you will regret it!
1010005.ch: 现在放走我，来日你可要大大的后悔！

1010006.en: Hear me now. If later I should be the more fortunate, I would not let you off!
1010006.ch: 事先声明，如果以后是我占了上风，是绝不会放过你的！

1010007.en: I will not forget this gift, good person, and I will be sure to pay you back tenfold someday.
1010007.ch: 我一定会记住阁下今日所赐，日后亦必十倍奉还。

1010101.en: I would rather die in battle than beg for mercy! Kill me, I don't care!
1010101.ch: 我宁可死于战场，也不会低头求饶！要杀便杀！

1010102.en: Kill me, but don't humiliate me!
1010102.ch: 要杀便杀，莫要羞辱于我！

1010103.en: I will not surrender to you! I'll have the sword!
1010103.ch: 我绝不会屈服于你，赶紧给我一剑！

1010104.en: I'd rather die on my feet than live on my knees!
1010104.ch: 我只要站着死，决不跪着生！

1010105.en: Don't be absurd. Hurry up and kill me now! I'll die before I surrender!
1010105.ch: 不要废话，赶紧杀了我，宁死不降！

1011102.ch: 成功从{name|B}处获得了<r>{taoistHeart|B}</r>的传承。

1011301.en: Raid the territory at the cost of 50 Stamina?
1011301.ch: 是否消耗50精力，潜入领地掠夺资源？

1011401.en: One day, you will pay for this!
1011401.ch: 你这样抢劫东西迟早会遭报应的

1011501.en: Since you lost, I'll keep you as my servant for 3 months.
1011501.ch: 既然你已经败了，那就留下来帮我看守三个月吧

1011601.en: Your Sect Leader paid the ransom. Now get out of here!
1011601.ch: 既然你们宗主愿意用资源将你赎回，那你就滚吧

1011701.en: The full-out attack is in 2 months to take the resource point!
1011701.ch: 两个月后全体进攻！努力抢下资源点！

1011801.en: Your sect is attacking a resource point. All disciples are requested to head over!
1011801.ch: 宗门正在进攻资源点，宗门弟子速速前往！

1011901.en: Your sect's resource point is under attack. All disciples are requested to head over!
1011901.ch: 宗门资源点在被进攻，宗门弟子速速前往！

1012401.en: The sect that once owned the resource point no longer exists or has left the region. Resource node captured.
1012401.ch: 资源点原归属宗门已经不存在或离开本州，我方直接占领了。

1012501.en: Your sect attacked and occupied a new territory.
1012501.ch: 我宗部队进攻了领地，获得了胜利，增加了一块领地。

1012701.en: Your sect attacked a territory but failed to occupy it.
1012701.ch: 我宗部队进攻了领地失败，未能获得领地。

1012801.en: Your sect failed to defend a territory and lost it.
1012801.ch: 我宗没有守住领地的入侵，丢失了一块领地。

1012901.en: Sect leader, we found a territory within our reach. Do you want to attack it?
1012901.ch: 宗主，刚刚发现一块领地可以攻击，是否要进攻？

1013001.en: With the Sect's development in mind, it has been decided that we will attack this Resource Point in two months' time. You shall lead the assault.
1013001.ch: 出于宗门发展考虑，决定两个月后进攻资源点，由你带领弟子主持进攻。

1013101.en: With the Sect's development in mind, it has been decided that we will attack this Resource Point in two months' time. You shall join the assault.
1013101.ch: 出于宗门发展考虑，决定两个月后进攻资源点，由你将跟随参与进攻。

1013201.en: I can't believe defense is so lax that they have no one here. What luck!
1013201.ch: 想不到防守如此松懈，竟然无人在此，真是幸运啊！

1013301.en: Looting a resource point may start a dispute. Are you sure you want to do this? (Costs 50 Stamina)
1013301.ch: 劫掠资源点或会掀起争端，你是否要这样做？（消耗50精力）

1013501.en: How dare you ask to have me serve a vanquished warrior!
1013501.ch: 哼，竟还要我伺候你这个手下败将！

1013601.en: I did not think that your Sect Leader would bear to pay the price to get you back!
1013601.ch: 我倒没想到，你们宗主还舍得花价码将你赎回去啊！

1013701.en: We will take the resource point this time! There is only victory!
1013701.ch: 此次进攻资源点，许胜不许败！

1013801.en: We've launched the attack on the resource point. All disciples must do their best! Hurry!
1013801.ch: 已发起对资源点的进攻，门中弟子都应尽力，请速速前往！

1013901.en: The enemy is attacking in force. Please send disciples to lend support as soon as possible!
1013901.ch: 敌方大举来攻，请门内弟子急速救援！

1014001.en: Impressive. They took over the resource point in one fell swoop!
1014001.ch: 了不起，竟然一举攻下了资源点了！

1014101.en: What a pity! We almost took the resource point!
1014101.ch: 可惜可惜！差点就能拿下资源点！

1014201.en: We wouldn't have been able to hold it so easily if it weren't for your help.
1014201.ch: 若非有你助阵，岂能轻易守住资源点？

1014401.en: It will be a waste to lose this resource point. We should operate a business instead.
1014401.ch: 此资源点就此丢空，着实浪费，倒不如由我们经营起来。

1014501.en: All the participants from our Sect were elites this time, so we took over the territory easily.
1014501.ch: 此次我宗参战人员个个都是精英，因此顺利拿下领地。

1014601.en: The Sect eventually held the territory because of good defense.
1014601.ch: 因为防守得法，最终宗门守住了领地。

1014701.en: My Sect lost in the attack on the territory and failed to take it.
1014701.ch: 我宗于进攻领地的行动中失利，未能将之拿下。

1014801.en: The enemy came in force and we could not resist the attack. This territory is lost.
1014801.ch: 敌人大举来犯，我们没能抵挡住进攻，这块领地保不住了。

1014901.en: I can take this territory with my fellow disciples. What do you think, Sect Leader?
1014901.ch: 该处领地由我带同弟子即可攻下，不知宗主意下如何？

1015001.en: If we don't take this resource point, it will become a great disaster for our Sect. Please keep the big picture in mind and take the strategic point.
1015001.ch: 此资源点若不拿下，必成我宗腹心之患，请你主持大局，攻下据点。

1015101.en: The resource point is the lifeblood of the Sect. In two months, please join the main forces to attack this resource point together.
1015101.ch: 资源点是宗门命脉，两月后，请你参与到大部队去一起攻打这个资源点。
